title: Common
description: Shared building blocks for SewSure contract v1 (DRAFT). Lengths are millimetres; the UI converts to cm.

Id.description: Opaque server-issued identifier. Clients must not parse it.

SignedLengthMm.description: A signed length in millimetres (for residuals and coordinates).

Units.description: Every stored and computed length is millimetres.

RecipeId.description: Reviewed recipe identifier from content/recipes. The server checks it against the allow-list.

Parameters.description: Recipe parameters picked from the recipe's allow-list. Lengths must use a key ending in _mm; counts end in _count; everything else is a string or boolean option. Unitless numeric lengths are rejected.

Provenance.description: Where a record came from, so a screenshot can be traced to one revision and a mock is never shown as a verified run.

source.description: mock = fixture or stub data; live = produced by the deployed API and feasibility engine.

engine_version.description: packages/feasibility version that produced any state or check.

model_id.description: AI model deployment that proposed recipe IDs or text, if any. Never a source of geometry.

Money.description: An amount in minor units (e.g. cents) with an ISO 4217 currency. SewSure does not transfer funds.
